history.summary: A 2002 freehold 3BR in D12 (Balestier/Boon Keng fringe), large at 1463 sqft, priced $2.5M / $1709 PSF — the price is driven up by sheer size, not a premium per-foot. Freehold and generous space are pluses, but the 1.05km MRT walk, 24-year age and absent URA data make this a middling hold rather than a value buy.
history.rating_rationale: Freehold and 1463 sqft give an own-stay-friendly profile, but as an investment the $2.5M price is inflated by size (cheaper $1709 PSF is a function of a big floor plate, not a bargain). 1.05km/13-min to Boon Keng MRT is poor, the 2002 build is aging, and there is no URA appreciation/txn data to confirm the trajectory. D12 Balestier is a slow-appreciation district. Score 434/1000.
red_flags: $2.5M price inflated by 1463 sqft size — low PSF is not a discount
2002 build, 24 years old — maintenance and dated facilities
No URA appreciation/txn data; D12 Balestier appreciates slowly
